technical_and_design_decisions: Treat the increment as work in the existing Spring XD codebase and its samples, build, CI, benchmark, and integration-test repositories.
Implement the deployment migration using a small, explicitly versioned runtime SPI with repository-backed behavior retained through an adapter during migration.

Implement ModuleRunner as an independently executable Spring Boot-based component with dependency injection, externalized configuration, lifecycle management, and no mandatory dependency on xd-containers.
Use the existing project build and test conventions, adding focused unit, integration, and smoke tests rather than introducing a new test framework.
Use repeatable benchmark harnesses and representative datasets for jdbchdfs and TupleBuilder measurements, recording baseline and post-change results.
Prefer parameter handling that accepts normal user-facing values and performs escaping or quoting internally for GPDB, while preserving compatibility for existing callers where practical.
Add CI coverage for the install target in the existing CI system and keep the new job deterministic and suitable for repeatable verification.
Publish the XD and Kafka proof of concept as a self-contained samples repository example with configuration, startup instructions, and a minimal verification flow.
assumptions: The existing repositories, build infrastructure, CI credentials, and development environments are available and functional.
The specification does not identify the exact remaining DEBS challenge work; it is assumed to be a bounded final integration, packaging, and submission task rather than a new major feature.
Existing APIs and module implementations provide enough functionality to migrate incrementally without redesigning unrelated subsystems.
The required database environments for SQLServer and GPDB can be accessed through existing test infrastructure or manually provisioned test instances.
Performance work is limited to benchmark creation, analysis, and targeted tuning around jdbchdfs and TupleBuilder; it does not include broad platform-wide optimization.
The XD plus Kafka proof of concept is an example application and does not require production-grade security, high availability, or operational automation.
CI changes target the currently used CI provider and build tool; migration to a different CI platform is out of scope.
Documentation consists of repository README files, configuration examples, and developer-facing usage notes.

Estimates represent hands-on work-hours for one experienced developer and include normal code review preparation and local troubleshooting, but exclude waiting time for external approvals or infrastructure provisioning.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, build, CI configuration, deployment abstractions, benchmark suites, database integrations, and sample-repository conventions; define implementation boundaries and an execution plan.
Implement the assumed remaining DEBS integration or packaging tasks, run the required validation, prepare submission artifacts, and resolve final defects related to the challenge deliverable.

Create a CI job or build step that executes the install target, configure required dependencies and artifacts, handle expected environment differences, and validate successful and failure-path behavior.

activities.activity_name: Publish XD and Kafka proof of concept
activities.activity_description: Package the proof of concept for the samples repository, add build and runtime configuration, verify the XD-to-Kafka flow, and provide reproducible startup and usage instructions.

Review prior benchmark coverage and improvements, establish or refresh baselines, run representative jdbchdfs scenarios, analyze regressions and bottlenecks, and apply limited targeted optimizations where justified.
Define representative TupleBuilder benchmark cases, implement the benchmark harness and data setup, collect measurements, identify hot paths, and document tuning conclusions.

activities.activity_name: Design and implement simplified GPDB parameter UX
activities.activity_description: Trace current parameter parsing and escaping, define the user-facing syntax, implement internal quoting or escaping, preserve applicable compatibility behavior, and add focused unit tests.

activities.activity_name: Validate Sqoop behavior with SQLServer and GPDB
activities.activity_description: Run representative Sqoop jobs against SQLServer and GPDB, compare parameter behavior and generated SQL or commands, fix compatibility issues discovered during testing, and record UX differences.
Define SPI interfaces, lifecycle and error semantics, configuration contracts, compatibility boundaries, and the adapter strategy for existing repository-based stream and job definitions.

activities.activity_name: Migrate module deployment to the runtime SPI
activities.activity_description: Implement the SPI, migrate deployment flows from the repository abstraction, add the repository adapter, update dependency wiring and configuration, and remove or isolate obsolete direct coupling.

activities.activity_name: Test and stabilize the deployment SPI migration
activities.activity_description: Add unit and integration coverage for SPI implementations, adapter behavior, lifecycle transitions, failure handling, and backward-compatible deployment scenarios; fix defects found by the test suite.

Define the executable boundary, bootstrapping model, configuration properties, module lifecycle, container integration points, logging, exit behavior, and packaging requirements for an isolated runner.

Build the Spring Boot application, wire the runtime SPI and module lifecycle, support external configuration and container-friendly execution, package the executable artifact, and remove the hard runtime dependency on xd-containers.

Exercise startup, configuration, module deployment, shutdown, restart, error handling, and execution in a representative container-managed environment; correct integration defects and stabilize packaging.
Update developer documentation, migration notes, CI and benchmark instructions, ModuleRunner usage documentation, sample README content, and release or submission artifacts.

activities.activity_name: Full regression, quality verification, and final cleanup
activities.activity_description: Run the relevant unit, integration, benchmark, build, and CI validations; inspect changed APIs and configuration; perform final cleanup, defect correction, and delivery packaging.
